spans.s: भृश् vi. 4P (pres. भृश्यति) To fall down.

भृश a. (f. शा; compar. भ्रशीयस्; super. भ्रशिष्ठ) Intense, much, exceeding, strong.(भृशम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) exceedingly, excessively, intensely, violently, extremely, in a high degree, रघुर्भृशं वक्षसि तेन ताडितः R.iii.61, चुकोप तस्मै स भृशम् R.iii.66, Rt.i.11; (2) beautifully.)

भृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Fried, parched, roasted, baked.
भृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) Fried, parched, roasted, baked.
भृष्ट-अन्न n. rice boiled and fried.
भृष्टि f. 1. Frying, parching; 2. a deserted garden.
